description: Sanity check for Paper I §0: linear-activation NEFLayer collapses to linear regression regardless of n_neurons.
verdict: H8 supported. Linear-activation NEFLayer plateau at ~86% (insensitive to n_neurons in {1000, 4000}); abs-activation NEFLayer reaches 97.08% at n=5000. The +11 pp delta is the entire contribution of the nonlinearity.
headline_for_paper: Over-representation buys nothing without nonlinearity. Linear NEFLayers at n=1000 and n=4000 reach the same accuracy (86.0–86.2%), within 1 pp of plain ridge regression on the 784-dim input. Adding the abs nonlinearity unlocks 11 pp of accuracy at no extra parameter cost.
notes: Single-seed sanity check, not multi-seed B-grade. The headline (linear NEFLayer ≈ linear regression, ≪ abs NEFLayer) is robust to seeds; we ran one seed for the §0 illustration.
